notes: V3.1 — Security hardening release. OS-keychain API-key vault (Electron safeStorage, no plaintext to the renderer), strict imported-protocol validation, external-URL allowlisting, WebSocket DoS limits (payload cap, per-IP rate limit, room/client caps, heartbeat), CORS allowlist + upstream timeout/size caps, and a stricter Content-Security-Policy with no inline scripts. Upgraded to Electron 42, plus native Apple Silicon (arm64) builds.
